title: Toi-Gye

symbol.name: Toi-Gye
symbol.meaning: The scholar Yi Hwang · ITF pattern 7 of 24

note.p: Toi-Gye is the pen name of the scholar Yi Hwang (16th century), an authority on neo-Confucianism. The 37 movements stand for his birthplace on the 37th parallel, and the diagram 士 means scholar. You start feet together in the middle of the short A–B line facing D: inner forearm blocks, low fingertip thrusts and slow back-fist strikes behind to B and A; an X-fist pressing block, twin punch, kick and punches down the stem; a slow twin elbow thrust and six stamping W-shape blocks along the long E–F line; a grab and knee kick; guarding blocks, low kicks and fingertip thrusts back up toward C; a jump into X-stance; then guarding and circular blocks to B and A and a final punch in sitting stance.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (37 movements, one technique each). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and F are the ends of the long line; AD and BD are the diagonals the circular blocks go toward. Finish by bringing the right foot back to close ready stance B.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in close ready stance B: feet together, the left hand wrapped over the right fist in front of the abdomen.
Turn left: move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left inner forearm middle block.
Slip the left foot forward toward B into a left walking stance. Right upset fingertip low thrust.
Bring the left foot to the right foot into a closed stance facing D. Right back fist side back strike toward C, the left arm extended down to the side, slowly.
Move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right inner forearm middle block.
Slip the right foot forward toward A into a right walking stance. Left upset fingertip low thrust.
Bring the right foot to the left foot into a closed stance facing D. Left back fist side back strike toward C, the right arm extended down to the side, slowly.
Move the left foot to D into a left walking stance. X-fist pressing block.
In the same stance, twin fist high vertical punch, flowing on from the pressing block.
Right middle front snap kick toward D, the hands held where they were.
Set the right foot down toward D into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
In the same stance, left middle punch.
Bring the left foot to the right foot into a closed stance, turning to face F. Twin side elbow thrust, slowly.
Stamp the right foot toward F into a sitting stance facing C. W-shape block, the right outer forearm leading.
Stamp the left foot toward F, turning clockwise into a sitting stance facing D. W-shape block, the left outer forearm leading.
Stamp the left foot toward E, turning clockwise into a sitting stance facing C. W-shape block, the left outer forearm leading.
Stamp the right foot toward E, turning counter-clockwise into a sitting stance facing D. W-shape block, the right outer forearm leading.
Stamp the left foot toward E, turning clockwise into a sitting stance facing C. W-shape block, the left outer forearm leading.
Stamp the left foot toward F, turning clockwise into a sitting stance facing D. W-shape block, the left outer forearm leading.
Bring the right foot to the left foot, then move the left foot toward D into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left double forearm low pushing block.
Slip the left foot forward toward D into a left walking stance, reaching both hands up as if to take hold of the opponent's head.
Right upward knee kick, pulling both hands down to meet it.
Lower the right foot beside the left foot, then move the left foot toward C into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Left low side front snap kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Set the left foot down toward C into a left walking stance. Left flat fingertip high thrust.
Step the right foot toward C into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Right low side front snap kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Set the right foot down toward C into a right walking stance. Right flat fingertip high thrust.
Move the right foot back toward D into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward). Right back fist side back strike toward D and left forearm low block toward C, together.
Jump toward C, landing in a right X-stance with the body turned to face A. X-fist pressing block, with a kihap.
Move the right foot toward C into a right walking stance facing C. Right double forearm high block, the left fist bracing the right arm.
Move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand low guarding block.
Slip the left foot forward toward B into a left walking stance. Right inner forearm circular block toward BD.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand low guarding block.
Slip the right foot forward toward A into a right walking stance. Left inner forearm circular block toward AD.
Pivoting in place, turn into a left walking stance facing B. Right inner forearm circular block toward BD.
Pivoting in place, turn into a right walking stance facing A. Left inner forearm circular block toward AD.
Move the right foot onto the A–B line into a sitting stance facing D. Right middle punch.
